notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400868/30ff944bef0b5198f20a23666b5d31e1dd6e25d8.png[/img]

[h2]🧩 New Level - Magic Squares[/h2]

Version 1.6.0 brings one new level. Arrange the numbers in the 3x3 grid to get the same sum on all rows, columns, and diagonals.

Good luck!

notes.title: Oct 24 2023 - 19 New Levels
notes.content:
[h1]🧩 New Content[/h1]
19 New Levels:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5WkJK7C.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Two Trains, One Track
[*] River Crossing: Explorers and Cannibals
[*] Chess Peace - 6 Queens
[*] Measuring Water, part 2
[*] River Crossing: Happy Family
[*] Chess Ring, part 1
[*] The Romulan Test
[*] Sliding Puzzle - 5x5
[*] Queen Domination: 6x6 Board
[*] River Crossing: Jealous Husbands
[*] Twelve Balls, One Scale - Easy Mode
[*] The Chasm, part 2
[*] Lights Out - 5x5
[*] Knight Domination, 8x8 Board
[*] Twelve Balls, One Scale - Hard Mode
[*] Cannonbowling
[*] Chess Ring, part 2
[*] The Towers of Hanoi - 7 Discs
[*] Chess Peace - 7 Queens
[/list]
More than double the fun. Best of luck and inspiration solving the new challenges!

[h1]📈 Increased Difficulty[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EnXdT2z.png[/img]
Some of the puzzles are VERY difficult. Take a deep breath and focus 🎯!

[h1]💲 Demo Available[/h1]
You can now download the demo and try the first few levels for free.

[h1]❤️ A Big Thank You[/h1]
❤️💛💙 Thank you for playing Puzzillion and for all your encouraging support. ❤️💛💙

notes.title: Sep 6 2023 Update - 8 New Levels
notes.content:
[h2]🧩 New Content[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ikqkt73.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Towers of Hanoi upgraded - 5 Discs
[*] Lights Out - Basic, 3x3 Building
[*] Sliding Puzzle - Basic, 3x3 Grid
[*] Chess Peace - 14 Bishops (must not attack)
[*] Bridge Crossing - Self Destructing Bridges
[*] Lights Out - Advanced, 4x4 Building
[*] Chess Domination - 3 Queens, 5x5 Board
[*] Sliding Puzzle - Advanced, 4x4 Grid
[/list]
A fair warning: Some of the levels are fairly difficult 😀

[h2]💾 Save Progress[/h2]

Your progress is now saved, so you if you stop at, say, Level 5, you don't need to complete levels 1-4 again next time you play.

[h3]↩ Revisit previous levels[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UdaAGky.png[/img]
You can choose to replay any level you previously unlocked / played.

[h2]💲 Switching to Paid[/h2]

With this release we're switching to a paid model, which will allow us to continue adding more interesting and cool puzzles. We're planning to add a demo with the first few levels soon. You don't need to pay for the game if you already have it in your library.

[h2]🔮 Going Forward[/h2]

Our plans for the future:
[list]
[*] more achievements
[*] more levels
[*] gameplay improvements and general polishing
[/list]
[h2]❤️ A Big Thank You[/h2]

❤️💛💙 Thank you for playing Puzzillion and for all your encouraging support. ❤️💛💙
